content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIAB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIAB JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NIAB JRF Recruitment 2026 is 17th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post at NIAB?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national level examinations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, along with 24% HRA if applicable.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NIAB JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the NIAB JRF Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF post at NIAB typically involves a screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The JRF positions at NIAB are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article by clicking on the provided link.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for the NIAB JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for the NIAB JRF Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB).
